title: docs: regenerate APIDOCS.md

pr_body_excerpt: Auto-generated from OpenAPI spec changes after a successful production deploy.

gist.headline: The map got pruned
gist.blurb: The API reference shed a lot of old leaves and grew a fresh copy from the production OpenAPI spec. Fewer stale branches, clearer paths through the garden.
gist.summary: Regenerated APIDOCS.md from the current production OpenAPI specification, replacing 908 outdated lines with the latest API reference.
gist.impact: Developers now have a much leaner, production-aligned API reference when wiring Pollinations into their projects.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden librarian pruning a huge outdated API manual into a tidy, glowing reference book beside a retro terminal. Use code-plants and small flowers to show documentation being refreshed from the live API.
